patch.summary:
Choose Adobe Firefly only if your buying job matches “Adobe generative image/video — Free credits; Firefly Standard from ~$9.99/mo; Pro ~$19.99;” rather than GitHub Copilot's shape. Choose GitHub Copilot only if your buying job matches “AI coding assistant in GitHub and IDEs — Pro $10/mo; Business $19/user; Enterprise $39/use” rather than Adobe Firefly's shape. Workflow advantage: Adobe Firefly leans ai-image; GitHub Copilot leans ai-code. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Positioning: Adobe Firefly is Adobe generative image/video — Free credits; Firefly Standard from ~$9.99/mo; Pro ~$19.99; also bundled in Creative Cloud.; GitHub Copilot is AI coding assistant in GitHub and IDEs — Pro $10/mo; Business $19/user; Enterprise $39/user; usage via GitHub AI Credits from June 2026..
- Workflow coverage skew: Adobe Firefly-leaning ai-image vs GitHub Copilot-leaning ai-code.
- Researched limits: Adobe Firefly — Premium video/partner models consume credits even when standard images are unlimited on paid plans; GitHub Copilot — Not Microsoft 365 Copilot — no Word/Excel Graph assistant.

Limitations — Adobe Firefly: Premium video/partner models consume credits even when standard images are unlimited on paid plans; Standalone pricing is easy to confuse with Creative Cloud Pro bundles; GitHub Copilot: Not Microsoft 365 Copilot — no Word/Excel Graph assistant; Usage-based AI Credits can exceed the $10/$19 sticker after included pool.

Poor-fit cases: Adobe Firefly is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Premium video/partner models consume credits even when standard images are unlimited on paid plans · GitHub Copilot is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not Microsoft 365 Copilot — no Word/Excel Graph assistant · Avoid Adobe Firefly if you actually need GitHub Copilot's motion (AI coding assistant in GitHub and IDEs — Pro $10/mo; Business $19/user; Enterpri)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
